title: Jodie's Memories and the Cherry Blossom Viewing Trap
notes: Recurring detective-cast nodes (Conan, Kogoro, Ran, Megure, Takagi, the Detective Boys) and the unrelated Black Organization/Bourbon-Vermouth-Jodie subplot (burn-scarred decoy, Amuro twin reveal) are omitted as unrelated to this case's suspect pool, consistent with the old file's own framing. Agasa is kept in (unlike the usual detective-cast omission) because his eyewitness account -- rod length, hat shape, dragging feet -- is the load-bearing testimony the whole solve is built on. No `event` node type: every action is a directly typed edge between the entities involved. The old lower-fidelity file (cases/ep734...) had the correct culprit (Yoriko Dan'no) and correct victim, but was thin: no witnesses at all (Agasa/Jodie missing despite being central to elimination), generic `knows` edges instead of real relationships, a single undifferentiated 'Shrine grounds' location instead of the distinct murder site/bell area/purification trough/fortune racks the transcript actually distinguishes, and it omitted the two mechanisms that make the trick work (the GPS transmitter Yoriko planted in her own wallet to get pickpocketed on purpose and track Kurobee, and the elimination-by-physical-trait logic that clears Benzaki and Sakamaki). Those are added here; no culprit correction was needed. case_type: murder.

clues.desc: Agasa's dragging-feet silhouette matches only Yoriko: Sakamaki cannot walk at all without his cane (let alone drag his feet), and Benzaki's cough was a real cold, not a disguise adopted before he knew anyone was watching.

The coins left beside the body were Yoriko's year-old kept coins from her own theft, not the fresh blackened coins Kurobee had just stolen from her that day -- proof the killing was personal revenge, not another victim's retaliation.

Yoriko made an offering and rang the bell without ever noticing her wallet was missing; a real pickpocketing victim would have noticed reaching for coins, meaning she wasn't making a real offering at all -- she was dumping the murder weapon's coins into the box.

edges.detail: steals Yoriko's wallet and car keys a year before the murder
with the car keys gone, the asthmatic boy was locked in the car for hours before reaching a hospital
picks Jodie's pocket while pretending to be startled/bumped into her
pickpockets Benzaki sometime during the flower viewing
steals Yoriko's wallet a second time, present day -- this time deliberately allowed, to plant the GPS transmitter
pickpockets Sakamaki sometime during the flower viewing
hides the GPS transmitter in a wad of banknotes inside her own wallet as bait
uses a phone to follow the planted transmitter to within 5 meters, waiting until Ikuyo was somewhere isolated
strings roughly 200 coins from the offering box onto a shoelace to make an improvised rod
conceals the blood-spattered hat and coat under fallen cherry blossom petals
